title: Pinned worker and rollout placement policy support
observed_baseline: Worker scheduling-state filtering existed in generic and ML placement paths.
Worker labels existed on domain workers and lifecycle/labels commands existed in the controlplane.
Placement policy did not yet constrain by pinned worker or rollout target labels.
intended_behavior: A placement policy may set pinned_worker; when set, only that worker is eligible for new placement.
Generic and ML placement previews retain rejected candidates with operator-visible reasons, including conflicts between the pinned worker and workload requirements.
A placement policy may set label_selector and rollout.from_labels/to_labels; rollout.to_labels is the active target pool for new placements.
Controlplane supports signed worker-policy.apply.request and workload.pin.request events, validates correlation tags and idempotency, persists policy updates, and publishes status/result events.
out_of_scope: MCP tools and read-model adapters outside existing environment registry publication
